newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling slides further against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling slides further against dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling continued its downward slide against the dollar on Thursday and also registered a slight fall against sterling, central bank officials said.
Against the dollar, the shilling was quoted at a mean commercial rate of 617.7600 compared to Wednesday's 616.7700. Against sterling the shilling was 1,011.3056 compared to 1,005.9550.
Dealers attributed the fall to a demand for foreign currency and a shortage of forex by local commercial banks.
